payload.blocks: Landing phase 4 (branch work-data-model/p04b), and phases 5, 6 and 7 that depend on it
payload.headline: Phase 4: a 'plans/backlog/*' grant makes secretary and supervisor heads fail to launch

parts.cause: src/runner/dispatch/session-attempt.mjs builds both the sandbox policy (requirementOf, line 47) and the envelope session.writes (line 137) from the same grant.writes list. The sandbox validator (confinement/workspace-paths.mjs:44 and its Rust copy) refuses any glob character. The reviewer ran grantOf+requirementOf through validateConfinementPolicyShape and the lead read the code. session-attempt.mjs is outside the plan footprint.

options.cost: About 5 src lines and one test case in session-attempt; one footprint land by the supervisor.
options.does: Add src/runner/dispatch/session-attempt.mjs and its owning test to the footprint; requirementOf maps a '<dir>/*' grant entry to '<dir>' for the sandbox, and session.writes keeps '/*' for session write.
options.gain: Keeps the '/*' grant you approved in q-y3ypxlucin; the sandbox binds the same directory it already binds via 'plans'; one small mapping in one place.
options.harm: One more file outside today's footprint; the supervisor has to land the footprint line, as it did for head_request.rs.
options.label: Open footprint to session-attempt.mjs

options.cost: About 15 src lines in head_request.rs and a test change.
options.does: Inside the footprint: head_request treats a glob-free grant naming a directory (e.g. 'plans/backlog') as allowing a plain file directly beneath it; grants use 'plans/backlog'.
options.gain: No footprint change; can land in this wave.
options.harm: Every existing directory grant changes meaning: secretary and supervisor hold 'plans', so session write could create or replace any top-level plans/*.md, including the generated plans/backlog.md. That widens a narrow door.
options.label: Directory grant without glob

options.cost: Removes about 100 lines from the branch.
options.does: Drop item-file creation from session write; heads write new items through their sandbox grant and land --paths, as the shaper does for discussions.
options.gain: No new grant syntax at all; smallest code.
options.harm: Reverses q-y3ypxlucin; the supervisor and secretary need a land per item instead of one session write.
options.label: No creation through session write

parts.recommendation: Option 1: it keeps your approved design and fixes the cause where the two uses of grant.writes split, with the smallest change. While the footprint line waits, the lead lands nothing from this branch.

scope.allows: Option 1: the supervisor adds src/runner/dispatch/session-attempt.mjs and its test file to the plan footprint, and a unit changes only requirementOf's path mapping and its test.
scope.forbids: Any change to the sandbox validator, to other grant consumers, or to the durable-file door.

parts.what: Phase 4 adds the grant 'plans/backlog/*' so session write can create new backlog item files. Review found that secretary and supervisor heads would then be refused at launch with 'path "plans/backlog/*" contains a glob character'. The branch is held until this is decided; the other review fixes go ahead now.
